page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and AES cryptography, but lacks AMX support. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark testing, the ecs.g7ne.4xlarge demonstrates stable mid-range performance across compute and memory workloads. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is measured at 1575.19, while multi-core performance reaches 16609.17. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read-only small block speed of 929.1 GB/sec, dropping to 97.46 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, and 51.81 GB/sec for large block writes. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 18072.94 and a PassMark memory score of 2643.85. For data processing, it handles single-threaded gzip compression at 26.87 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 79.18 GB/sec. Database operations are supported by a Redis SET throughput of 15.95 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 13.75 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the overhead of specialized hardware. The lack of local storage means users must rely on external block storage, which represents a tradeoff in I/O latency but allows for flexible storage scaling. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.g7ne.4xlarge is suited for general-purpose applications, including web serving, database operations, and moderate data processing tasks such as compression and decompression.
